interface.longDescription: v1tamins packages reusable AI development skills for reviewing code, consulting counterpart agents, writing tests, preparing PRs, improving documentation, debugging failures, routing ambiguous work into the right mode, learning from customers, testing product prototypes, reviewing usability, extracting reusable skills from source material, creating self-contained HTML artifacts, reviewing data graphics, diagnosing constraints, and keeping agent workflows consistent across projects. Plugin-distributed skills use a v1- prefix to avoid collisions with other public skills.
